reserveReview.rationale: Re-reviewed 2026-10-29. Reservoir documents wsrUSD as a yield-bearing token minted and redeemed through rUSD. Blockscout's fully verified Savingcoin source shows the constructor (name "Wrapped Savings rUSD", symbol "wsrUSD", admin 0xb7570e32dED63B25163369D5eb4D8e89E70e5602) setting the ERC-4626 asset to rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34, with deposit burning rUSD and withdrawal minting rUSD. At Ethereum block 26300200 (hash 0x5e82f30b5281d550458cee26f2cc41e229c41b8b762b986a193ec7570ff8cb09, 2026-10-29T18:29:47Z), public RPC eth_call reads on 0xd3fd63209fa2d55b07a0f6db36c2f43900be3094 returned asset() = rUSD, totalAssets() = 114,837,245.295357 rUSD, totalSupply() = 103,862,276.926083 wsrUSD (NAV about 1.1057), and rUSD.balanceOf(wrapper) = 0. The zero idle rUSD balance follows from the verified burn/mint accounting and is not evidence of a different direct reserve. The same-run Reservoir raw balance sheet reports $115,386,289.04 total assets, $115,138,203.44 total liabilities and $248,085.60 equity; wrap assets grew from 113,890,597.222 rUSD at the 2026-10-27 review. The direct composition is therefore a single 100% wrapper claim on the tracked parent rusd-reservoir, mirroring srUSD's claim on the same parent; the underlying reserve basket, strategy allocation, and custody remain upstream facts tracked on the rusd-reservoir record.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Verified Savingcoin ERC-4626 source/constructor and pinned Ethereum eth_call reads at block 26300200 (2026-10-29T18:29:47Z), corroborated by the same-run Reservoir raw balance sheet

custodyProfile.uncertainty: wsrUSD's direct underlying asset is rUSD 0x09D4214C03D01F49544C0448DBE3A27f768F2b34. The verified Savingcoin source burns rUSD from the depositor and mints wrapper shares; withdrawal burns shares and mints rUSD to the receiver. At Ethereum block 26095801 on 2026-10-01, asset() returned that rUSD address and rUSD.balanceOf(wrapper) was zero. The wrapper therefore does not custody an idle rUSD deposit balance. The prohibited rehypothecation annotation is scoped only to reuse of deposited rUSD by this wrapper: the verified burn/mint mechanics leave no deposited parent-token pool to lend or redeploy. It is not a legal prohibition on Reservoir's upstream reserve activity. Custody and economic reuse of the backing remain inherited from rUSD and its protocol-controlled adapters and are tracked on rusd-reservoir. The legal-safeguard annotations remain subject to upstream evidence; the Terms of Service and product documents do not identify a holder trust or bankruptcy-remoteness structure. Product documentation conditions immediate redemption on available PSM liquidity. At the same block, MANAGER Safe 0x4E8a4894275780f571AaD53122e641D9f50Ff04f remained 3-of-5, and EOA 0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602 retained DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
